entities.summary: Soumitra Chatterjee was a film actor, play-director, playwright, writer, thespian and poet who worked in Bengali cinema. He is regarded as one of the greatest and most influential actors in the history of Indian cinema. He is best known for his collaborations with director Satyajit Ray, with whom he worked in fourteen films.
